text:
lee.sr-support: Hey @nolan-customer — saw your support ticket about streaming responses cutting out and clients reconnecting repeatedly. Can you paste a short curl snippet you used?

nolan-customer: repro steps in ticket but here's condensed: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-x -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'  # gets data for ~10s then connection ends, client reconnects and gets duplicate tokens/billing.

ana-eng: thanks. Two quick Qs: 1) Is this happening behind Cloudflare/CF Workers or straight to ALB/NLB? 2) Any proxies/Ingress (nginx/Envoy) in between?

nolan-customer: we're behind Cloudflare (spectrum + WAF) -> ALB -> nginx sidecar -> app. We tested direct to app and it streams fine.

devin-netops: sounds like a proxy idle/half-close + buffering interaction. Common pattern: upstream keeps sending chunks, ALB or CF half-closes due to idle probe and downstream proxies buffer until window fills then release — clients see a final truncated flush and reconnect. Any access logs around the moment?

nolan-customer: attaching snippets from their logs: 

```
ALB: TargetHealthCheck: 200 OK, IdleTimeout=60s
nginx: proxy_buffering on; proxy_read_timeout 60s
app: stream started at 2026-03-10T14:22:01Z; sent 312 tokens over 9s
... connection reset by peer at 14:22:10Z
```

lee.sr-support: aha. Their ALB idle timeout is 60s but the pattern is shorter — could be Cloudflare closing idle front connection due to WAF or surge control. Another gotcha: nginx proxy_buffering=on will buffer small chunks and only flush when buffer full or upstream signals end. That explains partial output then a final release when reconnect happens.

ana-eng: repro suggestion for us: 1) curl -H "Connection: keep-alive" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -N to bypass buffering. 2) Use `envoy` or `socat` to simulate half-close / FIN from upstream. Example small test client: 

```
# repro client
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  'https://ALB.example/stream?debug=chunked'
```

devin-netops: also useful: tcpdump around the moment to confirm FIN vs RST. Capture filter: `host <client-ip> and port 443` then inspect with Wireshark for TCP FIN from ALB or Cloudflare.

nolan-customer: the tcpdump shows ALB sending a FIN after 60s of inactivity on the client side but the app was still streaming small keepalive chunks every 15s. So the ALB saw no client activity and closed.

lee.sr-support: that mismatch is classic: ALB expects application-level keepalive (data or pings) but small SSE chunks can be buffered by nginx or CF. Quick fixes: set `proxy_buffering off` in nginx for the route, set `sendfile off` and `tcp_nodelay on`, increase ALB idle timeout to >120s, and configure Cloudflare to disable response buffering / enable `stream` mode.

ana-eng: paste of recommended nginx snippet for docs: 

```
location /stream/ {
  proxy_pass http://upstream;
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
  proxy_read_timeout 300s;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
}
```

devin-netops: for ALB: increase idle timeout in the target group (or LB) to 300s while they validate. For Cloudflare: turn off "Response Buffering" or use a route with ``Disable Apps``/Disable WAF tests. For CF Workers, make sure `fetch()` isn't awaiting body aggregation.

nolan-customer: thanks — we've toggled proxy_buffering off and bumped ALB to 300s. Testing now. One more: is there any recommended client-side retry logic to avoid double-billing on reconnect?

lee.sr-support: yes — include an idempotency/retry-token returned by the server for each streaming session. If the client reconnects, send last-token marker; server can dedupe output or continue from last checkpoint. We also recommend exponential backoff with jitter and accepting partial results rather than immediate full replay.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: nginx-sidecar config will be rolled out to staging with `proxy_buffering off` for /stream/* at 2026-03-11T01:00Z. Monitor metrics: streaming-error-rate, reconnect-rate, tokens-per-session.

nolan-customer: after changes — stream stayed open for 8m, no premature close. Partial chunks gone. Will run load tests and confirm billing duplicates are resolved. Really appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:

lee.sr-support: great! If you see any residual P99 latency spikes, ping us and we'll pull traces. Also file a follow-up if you want help adding server-side resume tokens.

ana-eng: logging note: we should add a short section in our docs about proxy buffering + SSE for customers (nginx/ALB/CF common combos). Opening a small KB item.

devin-netops: captured tcpdump pcap and annotated timeline saved to the ticket for future postmortem.

nolan-customer: closing loop — all good so far, will reopen if anything else shows up.
